message.content:
Someone is going at The Card Corner \(Leuven\) on Sat 17 Oct, 19:00.
Coming too? Click Going.

To prove Anna#EUW is yours, set your League profile icon to **Debonair Rose Icon** (icon 7, a starter icon), then press Verify. Search for it by name in the client's icon picker, or pick the icon shown below. It can take up to 5 minutes to show up. You can change it back afterwards.

This deletes everything ni han bao has stored about you, in every server: your message, reaction, voice and game time counts, your name and avatar, your membership, your regular stores, the events you are going to, your linked League account with its ranks and games, your Riftbound collection, decks and lending setting, your card loans (gone for the other member too), your profile visibility and your /hide-me setting. It cannot be undone. The bot stops counting you until you use /show-me. You also lose access to the servers' pages on the website until then.
